posts.title: Nobody Understands the Riemann Proof. That's the Point.
posts.description: A 17-million-line Lean proof of the Riemann Hypothesis was certified in a day by people who can't read it. How that works, what it does and doesn't prove, and why it matters for anyone drowning in AI-written code.

posts.title: ARTEX: The attack that runs through your LLM gateway
posts.description: Attackers' AI agents sent Amazon's fake LLM APIs their plans. What the FBI's ARTEX warning means for the gateway between your agents and your models.

posts.title: Black October: A Security Filter, Switched Off by a Name
posts.description: Finding the bug took a day. Writing the fix took an hour. The handoffs took two weeks. How a policy bypass in vLLM Semantic Router's Istio integration works, how to check for it, and what it would take to fix faster.
